description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. AGSC-06-14 — 'Every published item MUST be reachable from /llms.txt, directly or through a listed cluster section' — is a MUST over the discovery surface. Derivation from the rule plus the layout of AGSC-06-13a that disc-0013 pins: an item carrying `clusters[]` is reachable through the section of its FIRST (primary) cluster when that cluster is listed; an item carrying no cluster, and an item whose primary cluster is not listed, are reachable only through the `Other` section, so a writer that lists neither fails this rule. `sable` is clustered under an unlisted cluster and must therefore appear under `Other` beside the unclustered `loose-note`. A `draft` item is not published (AGSC-02-23) and is neither reachable nor a fault. /llms-full.txt carries the same index plus item bodies, so the two reachability sets are identical.
